old_caption: The video begins with a view of a staircase leading upwards, flanked by a stone wall on one side and a wooden fence on the other. The ground is covered with dry leaves, and colorful plastic balls are scattered across the steps and the surrounding area. The camera moves forward along the staircase, revealing more of the staircase and the scattered balls. The background evolves with the camera's movement, with the wooden fence and stone wall providing a natural backdrop. The overall scene suggests an outdoor setting, possibly a park or a garden, where someone has placed the balls for some kind of activity or game.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a view of a staircase leading upwards, flanked by a stone wall on one side and a wooden fence on the other. The ground is covered with dry leaves, and colorful plastic balls are scattered across the steps and the surrounding area. The camera pans slowly to the right, revealing more of the staircase and the scattered balls. As it continues, the camera moves closer to the top of the stairs, showing a green bucket filled with more colorful balls. A hand reaches into the frame, picking up the bucket and holding it momentarily before moving out of view. The background remains consistent throughout, with the wooden fence and stone wall providing a natural backdrop. The overall scene suggests an outdoor setting, possibly a park or a garden, where someone has placed the balls for some kind of activity or game.
caption: A low-angle view looks up a flight of wide concrete steps strewn with dry brown leaves and dozens of small, smooth, brightly colored plastic balls in red, green, blue, and yellow. The camera gradually pulls back and pans to the right, revealing more of the upper staircase and the right-hand paved walkway. Several balls shift position relative to the step edges, rolling and bouncing across the treads. The yellow ball at the right edge moves steadily leftward and downward and leaves the frame. The green ball near the lower center shifts toward the right and settles mid-frame, while the adjacent blue ball oscillates vertically as if bouncing on a step. On the left steps, a green ball that sits between two red balls rolls across the tread to end up to the left of both. Most other balls remain at rest, their apparent leftward drift tracking the camera pan rather than their own motion.
